'''Shiana Trist''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Trist co-operated with the bounty hunters [[Drokka]] and [[K1-1R]], to try and collect [[Contract AA23]], a bounty that had been placed on the [[Heroes of Cularin]]. They attacked the heroes on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], but failed and Trist was able to escape.<ref name="CAA23">{{LivingForce|Contract AA23 (roleplaying adventure)}}</ref>

She later flew her [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], to try and capture the [[Liana Liberators]]. She put aside her previous grievances with the Heroes of Cularin and they helped her attack the Liberators.<ref name="TR">{{LivingForce|The Replacements}}</ref>
